::: {#hero-heading}

Multiomics scientist decoding cancer biology by integrating bulk, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomics with multi-omics data.

I build reproducible computational workflows on public omics data — meta-analysing bulk RNA-seq cohorts, constructing harmonised single-cell atlases, and applying machine learning to high-dimensional data for biomarker discovery.

Alongside research, I founded [DeepBio Limited](https://deepbioltd.com), a Dhaka-based AI and bioinformatics startup, and [CHIRAL Bangladesh](https://chiralbd.org), a non-profit research institute that has trained 3,000+ early-career researchers across Bangladesh. I teach bioinformatics through [DeepBio Academy](https://deepbioacademy.com) and mentor students moving from raw sequencing data to published analysis.

```{=html}
<script>
function showProgram(id) {
  // Update buttons
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-id') === id);
  });
  
  // Update content
  document.querySelectorAll('.program-content').forEach(content => {
    content.classList.toggle('active', content.id === id + '-content');
  });
}

function dismissProgramToast() {
  const el = document.getElementById('program-toast');
  if (el) el.classList.remove('program-toast-show');
  localStorage.setItem('program-toast-dismissed', Date.now());
}

window.addEventListener('load', function() {
  // If not dismissed in the last 24 hours, show it
  const lastDismissed = localStorage.getItem('program-toast-dismissed');
  const shouldShow = !lastDismissed || (Date.now() - lastDismissed > 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  
  if (shouldShow) {
    setTimeout(function() {
      const el = document.getElementById('program-toast');
      if (el) el.classList.add('program-toast-show');
    }, 2000);
  }
});
</script>
```
